newsitem.title: UK: UK govt rejects charge parts of budget were leaked.
newsitem.headline: UK govt rejects charge parts of budget were leaked.

text.p: Ann Taylor, leader of the House of Commons, said she had seen no evidence that parts of Wednesday's budget had been leaked.
Taylor rejected a demand by Peter Lilley, the main finance spokesman of the opposition Conservative party, that she set up a select committee to investigate the purported leaks.
"There is always speculation at the time of the budget about its contents," Taylor told parliament.

"I have seen no evidence that details of the budget statement have been leaked. If the complaints are that we are sticking to manifesto commitments and election pledges, then as the prime minister made clear we are happy to confirm that this is the case," Taylor added.
